content: OSC 11 terminal background detection pitfalls: (1) tmux historically did not support OSC 11 at all; newer versions support it but cache the value — color doesn't update until detach/reattach. (2) SSH + Windows Terminal + tmux: escape-time too short (default changed from 500ms to 10ms in tmux 3.5) causes OSC 11 responses to leak visibly in the terminal. (3) termenv Go library has OSC 8 not supported in tmux; graceful fallback to static theme is essential. (4) In non-interactive/pipe contexts (CI, git difftool subprocess), OSC 11 query will timeout or produce no response — must have timeout and fallback. (5) Reliable approach: check COLORFGBG env var, then try OSC 11 with short timeout, fall back to dark theme.
